question: Does extra weekly BTC structure and breadth at fixed day-31 recovery checkpoints distinguish durable recovery from bear-market rally without future information?
population: All nine historical fixed v8.1 recoveries, exactly +31 calendar days after 7-day phase confirmation
asOfRule: Evaluate only at CLOSE of the checkpoint UTC day, so Sunday fully closes at 00:00 UTC next day; use the latest Sunday whose closed candle date <= checkpoint day. Never use current incomplete UTC day. Historical weekly closing prices computed from verified v8.0 daily BTC close sequence, no look-ahead.

weeklyDefinition.weeklyClose: Sunday UTC BTC daily close from v8.0 source. 30wk SMA = 30 fully completed Sunday weekly closes inclusive. 4-week SMA slope = percent of current 30wk SMA versus same 30wk SMA four Sundays earlier.
weeklyDefinition.structure: Last four weekly closes' max vs preceding four weekly closes' max AND last four weekly closes' min vs preceding four weekly closes' min; these are W1 CLOSE structure not intrawick OHLC highs/lows.
weeklyDefinition.confirmedTrend: Weekly close > 30wk SMA AND slope(30wk SMA vs 4w ago)>0 AND both 4wk high-of-closes and low-of-closes rising

breadthDefinition.source: Reopen v8.0 per-asset validated daily close snapshots; each snapshot SHA256 verified against v8.0 report; no backfill before listing
breadthDefinition.perf: 30 day relative cumulative performance of asset versus BTC from identical checkpoint start/end dates, via (assetReturnFactor/btcReturnFactor)-1, not approximate difference
breadthDefinition.sixAlts: Outperform BTC 30d fraction among six fixed alts; any missing 30d asset produces UNKNOWN_BREADTH, not a zero
breadthDefinition.broadParticipation: ETH/BTC positive AND at least 4 of six alts outperform BTC in same 30d window

outcomePolicy: Reuse EXACT frozen v8.1 future returns and bear/bull transition outcomes from day31; do not relabel them. Compare each episode, not only successful ones. Future unavailable means RIGHT_CENSORED.
tests: Report exact per-case features, classification and future 30/90/180 outcomes/censor
Report observed 90d median, count and percent positive by category only descriptive
Report 90d confirmed-bear and 180d confirmed-bull event counts by category with censor
Compare present day31 versus historical closest category; if n<20 or category n<5, classify LOW_SAMPLE
Do not fit weights, change thresholds, compute actionable win rate or optimize in response to outcomes
macroETF: Independent contextual audit at current date: 5/10-session BTC spot ETF net flows sourced from Farside; latest H4.1 release (weekly Fed balance sheet); indicate they are not in model, not full financial liquidity, and not comparable across 2020-2023. Do not include live web info in the same historical JSON as fact unless time/source verified.
guards: Exact v8.0 and v8.1 parent SHA match
8 original daily source snapshot SHA match
No missing weekly close at current date, no silently substituted futures/spot
Current BTC v8.0 17-Oct close must match last day v8.1 checkpoint price
All nine checkpoints exactly reproduce original v8.1 input; no changed sample
No changes to NAV, capital, trading, Spot, Futures, risk limits, runtime detector or BTCI governance
limitations: Posthoc subset and chosen thresholds cannot validate an independent predictive edge
Only 8 previous recovery episodes; results susceptible to regime autocorrelation
Weekly price CLOSE structure only, not full weekly OHLC for historical candles
Same asset selection today creates survivorship bias and missingness before listing
ETF only available after January 2024, macro vintages not archived
This is a phase context / risk filter research, not trade/position advice
